app.name: Field Shift
lang.label: Language
field.heading: Demo fields
overview.title: Field overview
overview.lead: Conditions for this field, with the source and resolution of every value. Grid-cell values are not field measurements.
overview.normalHint: 1997-2025 mean for the same 30 days: {v} mm
overview.wetnessHint: 0 = dry, 1 = saturated. Modelled at grid-cell scale.
overview.ndviHint: 250 m pixel at the field centre; may include neighbouring land.
provenance.title: Where this value comes from
plans.title: Rotations compared
plans.lead: Exactly three rotations are scored with published rules. Rice to rice is always the baseline. Scores are decision support, not yield predictions.
plans.incomeNote: Not calculated — enter your price and cost.
plans.noIncome: Income is left out of the score until you give a price and a cost for all three crops.
priorities.title: Your priorities
priorities.lead: Weights are renormalised to 100. Income is disabled until prices and costs are entered.
econ.title: Your prices and costs (optional)
econ.lead: Per acre, in any currency. Sales minus cost is used only for ranking, never as a profit forecast. Both fields are needed for all three crops.
econ.disabled: Income stays out of the score until all six numbers are filled.
scenario.title: Scenario simulator
scenario.lead: A what-if, not a forecast. Change one or more assumptions and compare the same three rotations under the new conditions.
scenario.noChange: No assumption changed. Adjust a control to run a what-if.
scenario.noPlanChange: Scores do not change under this scenario.
scenario.rainNote: -20% applies to the dry-season rainfall average used by the rules. Dry-season rainfall is near zero here, so it mainly affects the monsoon. This is not a rainfall forecast.
agent.title: Analysis steps
agent.lead: A deterministic, scripted log of the analysis. No live language model is called.
agent.simNote: Simulated clock, not real time. The moving marker visualises the analysis workflow; no vehicle or satellite travels to the field.
quality.title: Data & Quality
quality.lead: One screen for judges and advisers: every dataset, its status, and what the cleaning pipeline changed.
quality.noReport: No cleaning report in this build.
quality.pipeline: Missing-value checks · range checks · duplicate date checks · unit checks · source-to-UI traceability.
footer.disclaimer: Decision support only — not a yield forecast or agronomic prescription. Check with local extension officers before deciding.
footer.data: Data: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, NASA SMAP, NASA MODIS, ISRIC SoilGrids. Demo field geometry.
footer.built: Built for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Yangon.
common.error: Could not load the field snapshot.
map.title: Field map
map.scenarioScope: Changes apply to this field only. This compares crop plans using the current rotation rules.
overview.nutrientsNote: Fertilizer use and soil nutrient levels are unavailable. The soil pH estimate helps describe acidity. Use a local soil test before choosing fertilizer or a rate.
map.offline: Map tiles unavailable. Field outlines are shown on a plain background.
rec.title: Recommended next dry-season crop
rec.tie: Tied first place at these priorities
rec.basis: Top-ranked of 3 plans for your priorities. A starting point to check locally, not a prescription.
map.attributionEsri: Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics (not NASA)
map.esriNote: High-resolution imagery (Esri World Imagery, not NASA). Capture date varies by area.
rec.basisShort: Higher scores mean a better fit for this field.
overview.imergHint: Last 30 days, observed by satellite (0.1° cell, about 11 km). Compare with the modelled POWER rain.
overview.smapHint: Top 5 cm, 9 km grid cell: district scale, not a field measurement.
mine.deleteConfirm: Delete this field and its measurements?
draw.title: Draw your field
draw.help: Tap each corner of your field on the map, going around in order.
draw.name: Field name
readings.title: Your field measurements
readings.lead: Enter what you measured or see in this field. The plans use your values instead of the satellite estimates.
readings.phHint: From a soil test kit or lab.
readings.water: Does water stay 2 or more days after heavy rain?
readings.irrigation: Can you irrigate in the dry season?
readings.rainHint: Optional. Shown next to the satellite rainfall.
overview.userRainHint: Your own measurement for this field.
mine.heading: Your field
home.sub: Here is what the data says about your field.
glance.title: Your field at a glance
cond.title: Key conditions
cond.note: These are estimates from satellites and weather models, not direct field measurements.
act.scenSub: Try later planting or less rain
cal.title: Crop calendar
cal.note: Assumed dates for the Delta. Pre-monsoon rain is a 1997–2025 average, not a forecast.
fields.title: Your fields
fert.title: Fertiliser guide for {crop}
fert.perAcre: Per acre. Rate the Department of Agriculture uses in its monsoon variety trials.
fert.legume: Pulses fix their own nitrogen from the air, so they need only a little urea. Growing them after rice helps the soil.
fert.sourceLink: Myanmar Department of Agriculture, Seed Division
fert.caution: A general published rate, not a rate worked out for your field. Check with your township extension officer or a soil test.
fert.unchecked: No published rate checked yet for this crop. Ask your township extension officer.
field3d.enterHint: Walk into the field and try a rotation
field3d.title: {name} · field view
field3d.disclaimer: Illustrative scenario, not a yield guarantee.
field3d.noWebgl: 3D view is not available on this device. Showing a simple field view instead.
field3d.noPlans: No rotation plans could be computed for this field.
field3d.noClim: Weather normals unavailable for this field. Weather is held constant.
field3d.cardsSub: Ranked by the engine for this field. Pick one to plant it.
sim.rainNote: Modelled rainfall, lower than local gauge totals. Indicative only.
sim.normalsNote: NASA POWER day-of-year normals, not a forecast.
sim.event.start: Paw San rice standing, close to harvest
sim.event.late_sowing: Sowing window has passed: {crop} sown as soon as the land is ready
sim.event.heat: Heat stress: {t} °C is above the {limit} °C limit for {crop}
sim.event.no_irrigation: {crop} needs irrigation in the dry season, but this field has none
sim.event.data_gap: Weather value missing for this day; last value reused
sim.summaryVs: Compared with your usual rotation (Rice → Rice), same field and weather normals
sim.summaryRank: Engine ranking for your priorities: rank {n} of {total}.
